description: Find ABS statistical tables (dataflows) by topic words, geography level or frequency. Matches table names, topics and dimension names, and also option labels inside dimensions — a search for 'rent' finds CPI through its INDEX option 'Rents' and reports the match in matchedOptions. Census tables published at several geography levels are collapsed to one result with familyGeographies listing the others (use the geography filter to pick one). Every result has data. When the person describes a situation rather than a dataset, search for each thing it depends on (prices, wages, rents, population...). Start here, then describe_table.

frequency.description: A annual, S semi-annual, Q quarterly, M monthly, W weekly, D daily

geography.description: Restrict to a geography level, e.g. SA2, LGA
